title: RareDx: Controlled Knowledge Integration and Graph-Grounded Policy Optimization for Rare-Disease Diagnosis
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Rare-disease diagnosis is a long-tail reasoning problem: phenotypes are incomplete, individual disorders are sparsely documented, and relevant evidence is distributed across ontologies, gene annotations, and biomedical text.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across eight benchmarks, the complete RareDx system centered on Qwen3.5-9B reaches 38.34 macro Hit@10, 1.60 points above GPT-5.5 under the archived protocol; a disjoint validation-selection audit retains a 6.80-point routing gain over Direct on held-out cases.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: RareDx-Harness normalizes heterogeneous records into one ranked-diagnosis task and compares direct inference, static retrieval, adaptive tools, and structured phenotype-gene-disease reasoning over a shared knowledge layer.
